name: The Ritz-Carlton, Bangalore
positioning: City-centre Ritz-Carlton on Residency Road with a large art collection, jaali-inspired design and a lineup of restaurants and bars
best_for: Travelers who want a central Bangalore base with many dining options
Guests interested in art, with a guided art walk at the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is centrally located on Residency Road in Bangalore.
Zarqash serves North Western Frontier cuisine, including kababs and biryanis.
Zarqash has an enotica, a whiskey table, two private dining rooms and an interactive live kitchen.
Izu serves Japanese Nikkei fusion cuisine.
Yàn Yǎn is a modern Chinese restaurant and dim sum house.
BANG is a rooftop bar with panoramic views of the city.
The hotel has a wellness floor with a spa, a gym and an outdoor swimming pool.
The spa draws on Indian and Western traditions.
Rooms and suites blend modern silhouettes with traditional Indian design elements.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.

highlights.text: The hotel has a curated collection of over 1,200 artworks and a traditional jaali design woven throughout its architecture.
The Cloak Society is a theatre-inspired speakeasy cocktail bar.
The hotel offers a private exploration of Mysore Palace guided by a member of the royal family.
The Curator’s Art Walk is a guided journey across the hotel's collection of Indian masters and global contemporary artists.
The Spa Suite has dual treatment beds, a private steam and shower, and a Jacuzzi.

considerations.text: The nearest airport is Kempegowda International Airport, about 42 km from the hotel.
Club access requires an upgraded booking.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
